title: Straßenraum Suhl
unit: dm: absolute model coordinates in whole decimetres (x east, y north, z = NHN - H0), as in fahrt/strassen.json

areas.home: 1 in the tile of its reference point
areas.q: 1 plane through solved way nodes, 0 from the terrain
areas.x_areas: [surface, flags, name, [x, y, z, …], [holes]] – the layout the road map takes

fl.8192: eigens kartierter Gehweg neben einer Straße
fl.32768: führt in ein Gebäude (Einfahrt, Durchfahrt ohne Tunnel-Angabe)

numbers.osm: Geofabrik extract thueringen-latest.osm.pbf, cut with osmium
numbers.note_km: true metres (UTM) of the ways inside the tiles of the run, by the kind written into the drive data

heights.note: samples per source: tiles = the uncut ground tiles of suhl-boden (the one ground of all Suhl packages); copernicus = own sampling of Copernicus GLO-30 with the forest lowered (tools/welt/dem.py CopGround) where no tile holds the point
